## How do I save the lecture slides as a PDF?

Open the slides, add **`?print-pdf`** to the end of the address, and press
Enter. The deck redraws as a flat page, one slide per sheet. Then print
(`Ctrl`/`Cmd` + `P`) and choose **Save as PDF**.

So for lecture 6 you would visit:

```
.../slides/lecture-06_slides.html?print-pdf
```

Two things to set in the print dialog:

- **Layout: Landscape**
- **Margins: None**, and switch on **Background graphics** — without it the
  code blocks print as white boxes.

Speaker notes are not included, and neither is anything written on a slide
with the pen during class.
